component.name: Project Banshee
component.summary: Build a queue of music, videos and podcasts as fast as you type

description.p: Project Banshee is a queue-first player in the spirit of the classic Banshee. Search is focused when it opens: type, press Enter, keep typing. One queue mixes YouTube Music songs, YouTube videos, podcast episodes and Spotify tracks in any order.

ul.li: Instant fuzzy search that merges remembered and live results
Your YouTube Music and Spotify playlists, artists, albums, liked songs and podcasts
Queue, position and searches survive quitting
MPRIS media controls, Mini Mode and Share to Discord

description.p: Project Banshee is not affiliated with the original Banshee project.
Rewritten in Rust with a queue-first layout, fast fuzzy search, videos, podcasts, Spotify, a library and durable app memory.
